# BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Jacob Devlin, Ming-Wei Chang, Kenton Lee, Kristina Toutanova  
**Year:** 2018  
**Journal:** NAACL  
**DOI:** [10.18653/v1/N19-1423](https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/N19-1423)  
**Publisher:** [https://aclanthology.org/N19-1423/](https://aclanthology.org/N19-1423/)

**Keywords:** bert, pretraining, language model

## Abstract

We introduce a new language representation model called BERT which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers.
